red_flags: Many Google entries are 5-star with no written text ('Geen beschrijving') — rating-only, not substantive
Several written reviews are short one-liners ('Fijne lessen, aanrader!')
No verified-customer platform (klantenvertellen/Kiyoh) page exists for this school; rijschoolspecialist shows 0 reviews
Single-instructor school (owner Cristel), so reviews concentrate on one person and read uniformly glowing
review_summary: Students consistently describe owner-instructor Cristel as calm, patient and clear, praising her flexible planning and her skill with nervous/anxious learners, with many reporting they passed on the first attempt. The picture is uniformly very positive but rests mostly on short Google reviews and website testimonials, with no independently verified-customer reviews and many rating-only entries.
